detail.longDescription:
A client to manage your Vercel projects and much more. Bring your indie hacking journey everywhere you go with Rev!

▲ PROJECTS
- Most Recent Projects at a glance
- Browse All Projects on your team(s)

▲ DEPLOYMENTS
- Actions: Re-deploy, Promote, Rollback, and Cancel
- Distinguish the Current Live Deployment
- View Build Logs, Outputs, Source File Inputs and Functions
- Assigned Domains for Deployment (branch & commit specific)

▲ DOMAINS
- Actions: Add and Remove
- Domain Configuration Status (Valid/Invalid)
- Redirect Details
- Tap to copy for DNS details

▲ LOGS
- Build Logs in real time
- Function & Request Logs for any Project
- Expand Log Details
- Filters Galore

▲ OBSERVABILITY & FIREWALL
- Keep an eye on activity
- Respond to anomalies immediately

▲ ENVIRONMENT
- Add or Remove Env Variables
- Edit Environment Variables 


That’s it folks!

This text isn't gonna get any more interesting. I mean, I think we've pretty much covered all the good stuff. Still here? Ummmm, ok. How's everything? Good? Cool cool cool. 

What are you looking for? The app description is over. For real, check out the app. It's way better than hanging out in the App Store this long.

Wow, you're dedicated. Do you just love app descriptions? Weird. OK, we're gonna go now. Bye.


NOTICE & ACKNOWLEDGMENT
1. API tokens are stored locally on your device, and never leave it.
2. Rev is OSS (Open Source Software), feel free to open an Issue or PR at github.com/revcel/revcel
3. This is not a replacement for the Vercel website. Certain actions, such as creating new projects, should be done directly in the web dashboard.
